title: Lighthouse Watch Chronicle
premise: A coastal inheritance spanning decades. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with (false-friend C) / count (quantity E) / anchor (temporal A) metadata. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived and checked by complete_gt.py for memory iron rules and hard probe balance.
_state_note: Stateful entities use states:{label: standalone appearance for that state}; stateless entities use appearance. On transition, inject only the current state's appearance—never blend multi-state descriptions. Flashbacks may set state on a present item to point at a past state.

states.middle_aged_sturdy: A lighthouse keeper in his fifties, gray-white beard, thick deep-green waterproof coat and tall rubber boots, rough calloused hands, sturdy frame and steady stride, eyes distant and weary.
states.cane_twilight: The same keeper in old age: hair and beard fully white, face gaunt and sunken, stooped and walking slowly with a wooden cane, still in that faded deep-green old coat.
states.deceased: The lighthouse keeper has closed his eyes in death, lying still, face peaceful, no breath left.

states.youth: Young Mara: a lean fisher girl of fourteen or fifteen, deep-blue headscarf, coarse cotton fishing clothes, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult: Adult Mara: a tall steady fisherwoman in her twenties, still in that deep-blue headscarf and coarse cotton fishing clothes, eyes bright and firm.

states.intact: A thick old ledger, corners capped in polished brass, deep-brown leather cover intact, yellowed pages packed with ink.
states.salt_weathered: The same ship's log salt-bleached by sea wind: cover whitened and curling, pages damp and wrinkled, writing bled.

states.intact_rotating: A man-tall rotating Fresnel lens of intact concentric glass prism rings, turning at even speed, refracting a sharp white beam.
states.cracked: The same Fresnel lens burst with glaring cracks, some glass prism rings damaged, the rotating beam broken by gaps.
states.repaired: The Fresnel lens cracks filled with newly set glass prism rings, restored intact, the beam sharp and steady again.

states.intact: A small indigo wooden fishing boat, a white petrel with spread wings painted on the bow, old tire fenders hanging along the gunwales.
states.sunk: The indigo fishing boat overturned by a giant wave, mast snapped, wreckage sinking into the surf.

states.youth: Young Lena: twin sister nearly identical in face to young Mara, ochre-red wool shawl, bold expression, a shell hairpin at her temple.
states.adult: Adult Lena: nearly identical in face to adult Mara, still in ochre-red shawl with shell hairpin at the temple, bold expression.

E7.name: lighthouse
E7.appearance: A white granite lighthouse standing on a black rocky headland, tall and slender, glass lantern room at the top, sea fog year-round.

E8.name: lantern room
E8.appearance: The circular glass lantern room atop the lighthouse, brass railings around, Fresnel lens in the center, endless sea beyond the windows.

E9.name: rocky shore
E9.appearance: The black rocky shore at the lighthouse foot, breaking waves, scattered old fishing nets, glass floats, and driftwood.

E10.name: fishing village market
E10.appearance: An open-air market in the small fishing village across the bay, fish baskets and salted fish under wooden sheds, nets on drying lines, people coming and going.

E11.name: memorial plaque
E11.appearance: A brass memorial plaque nailed to a granite base, engraved with the keeper's name and years, edges already verdigrised.

E12.name: glass floats
E12.appearance: Three palm-sized old glass floats, frosted with salt, tied with hemp rope to a wooden stake on the rocky shore.

E13.name: Seagull
E13.appearance: A brand-new vermilion motor rescue boat, white 'Seagull' lettering sprayed on the hull, orange life rings hung on the rail.

E14.name: harbor master
E14.appearance: A lean harbor master, full beard, deep-blue uniform coat and peaked cap, crisp bearing, somewhat resembling the lighthouse keeper.

E15.name: spare oil lamps
E15.appearance: A row of five brass spare oil lamps hung on iron hooks on the lantern-room wall, glass covers polished bright.

E16.name: brass fog bells
E16.appearance: Two brass fog bells hung under the lighthouse eaves, bodies faintly gleaming, low-toned fog warnings when the wind rises.

E17.name: Sara
E17.appearance: A fisher girl from across the bay, light-brown headscarf, dusty coarse cloth clothes; at a glance somewhat like young Mara, but sharper chin and shy gaze.

E18.name: spare prism
E18.appearance: A half-man-tall spare prism, concentric glass rings much like the main lens, but smaller, with a black-iron base.

E19.name: new fishing boat
E19.appearance: A strange blue-gray motor fishing boat, broad flat hull, no petrel emblem, not the same as the Petrel.

features.E2: Mara: deep-blue headscarf, coarse cotton fishing clothes.
features.E6: Lena: face nearly identical to Mara, but ochre-red shawl, shell hairpin at the temple, bold expression.

lookalike_pairs.note: Twin confuse: tests both 'when only one is present, do not draw the other' (S4) and 'when both share a segment, bind features correctly' (S5/S16).

scenes.setting: Lantern-room dusk routine (introduce five oil lamps · two fog bells)
actions: At dusk, lighthouse keeper Elias climbs the spiral iron stair into the lantern room and lights the central Fresnel lens.

actions.action: A row of five brass spare oil lamps hangs on the lantern-room wall; Elias polishes each glass cover one by one.
Two brass fog bells hang under the lighthouse eaves; Elias reaches out and lets them ring gently.

actions: Elias circles the Fresnel lens, checking every glass prism ring.
Elias looks out the window at the darkening sea.

actions.action: The Fresnel lens rotates at even speed, casting a white beam toward the night sea.

actions: Elias sits in a lantern-room corner and dozes by the light.
Elias opens the ship's log and dips ink to record the day's tides.
Elias draws a wave-height curve in the ship's log.
Elias closes the ship's log and returns it to the wooden box by the brass railing.

actions.action: The Fresnel lens beam sweeps the lantern room, lighting Elias's profile.

scenes.setting: Rocky shore meets the apprentice (introduce three floats)
actions: On the morning rocky shore, Elias greets young Mara as she poles the indigo Petrel to shore.

actions.action: Mara jumps down from the Petrel and ties the hawser to the rocks.
Elias points to the three glass floats tied to the wooden stake, teaching Mara to read the fishing season.
Mara crouches by a tidal pool on the rocky shore, studying the anemones with curiosity.
Elias points at the sea, explaining the current's path to Mara.
Mara looks back at the moored Petrel, eyes full of longing.

actions: In the noisy fishing village market, Lena in an ochre-red shawl turns to look from behind a fish shed.
Lena picks through salted fish at a stall in the fishing village market.
Lena haggles with a market vendor; the shell hairpin at her temple sways slightly.
Lena carries a bamboo basket through the crowd of the fishing village market.
On the rocky shore, Mara and her sister Lena stand side by side—one in a deep-blue headscarf, one in an ochre-red shawl.
Mara hands Lena a found glass float; the two smile at each other.
Lena straightens Mara's deep-blue headscarf; the sisters walk slowly along the shore.
Mara and Lena part at the rocky shore, each walking opposite ways.
Months later at night, Elias keeps watch alone in the lantern room; the Fresnel lens turns quietly.

actions.action: Elias opens the ship's log; years of sea wind have salt-bleached the cover white and curled its edges.

actions: Elias wipes salt fog from the Fresnel lens.
Elias stands by the lantern-room window, gazing at the black horizon.

actions.action: The Fresnel lens beam sweeps slowly through the mist.

actions: Seasons turn; day after day Elias climbs to the lantern room to light the lamp.
Another snowy night, Elias wraps his coat tight and keeps watch beside the Fresnel lens.
In spring fishing season, Elias watches returning boat lights from the lantern-room window.
At midsummer noon, Elias wipes the brass railings heated by the fierce sun.
Autumn fog thickens; the Fresnel lens beam struggles through the mist in the lantern room.
Another New Year's Eve, Elias keeps watch alone in the lantern room until dawn.

scenes.setting: Shore patrol (recall three floats · strange new fishing boat)
actions: At dawn, Elias patrols the rocky shore; the indigo Petrel lies in the shallow bay.

actions.action: Elias crouches to check the seams of the Petrel's hull.
Elias walks to the wooden stake; those three glass floats are still tied on the rocky shore.
A strange blue-gray new fishing boat passes the shallow bay—broad flat hull, not Elias's Petrel.
Elias stands on the rocky shore, logging the reefs exposed after the ebb.
Elias hangs fishing nets on wooden racks on the rocky shore.

actions: A storm rises suddenly; the lantern room shudders in the gale; the Fresnel lens shakes hard.
Wild waves pound; lantern-room glass reflects pale lightning.

actions.action: Thunder cracks; a glaring crack bursts across the Fresnel lens.
On the distant sea, the indigo Petrel pitches hard in giant waves.
One huge wave overturns the Petrel entirely; the mast snaps and she sinks into the surf.
In the lantern room, Elias lunges to the console and steadies the cracked Fresnel lens.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (Petrel old photo indirect cue · oil-lamp recall)

actions.action: The day after the storm, Elias stands in the lantern room, staring at the cracked Fresnel lens.
Elias runs a finger along the crack in the Fresnel lens, face dark.
Beside the chart in the lantern room, Elias writes down the date the Petrel was lost.
An old photo of the Petrel hangs on the lantern-room wall; Elias gazes at it a long time.
Elias takes one of the five spare oil lamps from the wall and sits alone by its faint light.
The damaged Fresnel lens still turns slowly with its crack; the beam has a gap.

scenes.setting: Repairing the lens (third state · spare-prism false friend)
actions: Weeks later, Elias brings tools and begins repairing the Fresnel lens.

actions.action: Elias takes a spare prism from a wooden crate; it closely resembles that Fresnel lens, yet is smaller.

actions: Elias carefully sets new glass prism rings into the Fresnel lens.

actions.action: The last crack is filled; the Fresnel lens is intact again, and the beam turns sharp once more.

actions: The repaired Fresnel lens rotates steadily; Elias watches it with relief.

scenes.setting: False friends: rescue boat and harbor master

actions.action: A vermilion Seagull enters the shallow bay, nothing like the long-sunk Petrel.
A full-bearded harbor master jumps onto the rocky shore and talks beside Elias; the two are similar in build.
The harbor master points at the vermilion Seagull, explaining the new patrol plan to Elias.
The Seagull sounds its horn and leaves; Elias alone on the rocky shore watches it go.

scenes.setting: New-apprentice false friend (resembles Mara but is not Mara)

actions.action: From across the bay comes fisher girl Sara in a light-brown headscarf; at a glance she somewhat resembles Mara of those years.
Sara practices tying a hawser on the rocks; Elias shakes his head—she is not Mara after all.

scenes.setting: Twilight years (keeper with cane · fog-bell long-range recall)

actions.action: Years later at dusk, fully white-haired Elias leans on a wooden cane, stooped beneath the white granite lighthouse.

actions: Elias leans on his cane and looks up at the towering lighthouse, gaze far away.

actions.action: Those two brass fog bells under the lighthouse eaves ring softly in the wind; Elias pauses with his cane to listen.

actions: Elias lays a cane-steady palm on the lighthouse's cold granite wall, as if saying goodbye.

actions.action: By day, adult Mara returns along the shore and hurries toward the lighthouse.

actions: At the lighthouse foot Mara reunites with cane-leaning Elias; the two embrace.

actions.action: Beside a sickbed inside the lighthouse, Mara holds Elias's gaunt hand.
Elias's breath fades; at last he closes his eyes and passes away.

scenes.setting: Relics · memorial (indirect cue avoiding the deceased)

actions.action: Elias's deep-green old coat still hangs behind the lantern-room door; Mara reaches out and gently strokes it.
Beside the lighthouse base, adult Mara stands before a newly nailed memorial plaque.
Mara's fingertips brush Elias's name engraved on the memorial plaque.

scenes.setting: Sisters reunite (adult twins · long-range return + co-present)

actions.action: Adult Lena comes from the fishing village and embraces Mara tightly beneath the lighthouse.

actions: Mara and Lena stand side by side by the lighthouse base—one calm-eyed, one bold in expression.
The sisters look at each other without words, at faces alike yet different.

scenes._comment: Each beat uses a temporal phrase to cue a past entity/shot, without names; anchor.resolves_to is for scoring. Avoid cueing deceased/destroyed entities (E1/E5) so removed ones do not reappear.

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—the girl tying a hawser on the rocks appears again.

anchor.phrase: the girl tying a hawser on the rocks

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the lantern room, a huge rotating lens is lit for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the rotating lens lit for the first time at the opening

actions.action: Flash back to that year's market—a figure in an ochre-red shawl with a shell hairpin at the temple flashes by.

anchor.phrase: the figure in an ochre-red shawl at that year's market

actions.action: Before the eyes again: that row of five old brass hand-lamps on the lantern-room wall.

anchor.phrase: that row of five old hand-lamps on the lantern-room wall

actions.action: Back to the black rocky shore of first meeting; waves pound, as they always did.

anchor.phrase: the black rocky shore of first meeting

scenes.setting: Close (log long-range return with state · floats long-range return)

actions.action: Mara opens that salt-weathered ship's log again and walks into the lantern room.
By the lantern-room stake, those three salt-frosted glass floats are still tied in place.
Mara takes up the watch of the Fresnel lens; the beam shoots toward the sea again.
